text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Injected transfers at 16 Primary substations, starting in October 2025 and February, April, and June 2026; shapes S2, S3, S4, and S6. Forecast origins after the transfer has ended, by time since its end, while a lag still lies inside it. Error is measured against the true unmodified power. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.'
